content: Official node-semver and SemVer 2.0.0 documentation defines >= as greater-than-or-equal comparison across numeric major, minor, and patch fields. Prerelease versions do not satisfy ordinary comparator ranges unless the comparator set includes a prerelease for the same tuple; build metadata is ignored for precedence. A local comparison for the current simple minima must reject malformed or prerelease outputs and compare all three numeric components.
